newsitem.title: UK: Calor says SHV made offer for remaining stake.
newsitem.headline: Calor says SHV made offer for remaining stake.

text.p: Calor Group Plc said in a statement that SHV Energy Holdings UK Limited had made an offer approach, by way of a scheme of arrangement, for the remainder of the company it does not already own at 300 pence per share.
SHV already owns 51.9 percent of Calor.
Calor's shares closed on Friday at 290-1/2p.
At 0723 GMT Calor shares were indicated at 300p.
The offer of 300 pence includes 40 pence by way of a special dividend payable by Calor.
The deal will be recommended to ordinary shareholders by Calor's independent directors.
Calor said shareholders could retain a six pence per share interim dividend to be paid on November 8.
It said a further announcement would be made as soon as possible.
